title: June 2025: Preferred Drivers feature is here
summary: Take control of your deliveries with Curri’s new Preferred Driver feature. Rebook your top-rated drivers and streamline every shipment. Learn more in our June 2025 update.
body_markdown:
We’ve released a new feature that gives you more control over your driver network. This month’s update starts with a simple but powerful shift—putting you in charge of who’s behind the wheel.


## **New feature: Preferred Drivers**


Every great team has a starting lineup—and now, your deliveries can too.


With our new **Preferred Drivers** feature, you can rebook drivers who impressed you most—along with the vehicle they operate. Whether they handled a complex route, arrived ahead of schedule, or simply made your day easier, you can now add them to your personal roster with one click.


▶️ *Watch \[NAME\], \[TITLE\], walk you through how to create your Preferred Driver list.*


\[Embedded unlisted YouTube video\]


Once a driver earns a 5-star rating from you, they’re eligible to be added to your **Preferred Drivers list** , giving you:


- **Consistency** – Rebook drivers who already know your routes, materials, and delivery preferences.
- **Efficiency** – Save time by working with drivers you’ve already rated highly.
- **Confidence** – Build a trusted delivery crew that feels like an extension of your own team.


Your operation runs better when the right people are behind the wheel.


### Start building your all-star lineup today.
